Question 12(a) [2 marks]: Distinguish between legal compliance and ethical responsibility.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Optics is a manufacturer of frames for glasses including everyday reading frames and sports frames. They have recently introduced new technology to reduce the amount of plastic in each pair of their new product line by 25%.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Demonstrates a clear understanding of the difference between legal compliance and ethical responsibility
1 marks: Provides some relevant information about legal compliance OR ethical responsibility

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Legal compliance is when a business must adhere to the laws set out by the government; failure to comply could result in fines or imprisonment, for example the Fair Work Act 2009 which sets out working rights. Whereas ethical responsibility is when a business goes above and beyond the law to engage in social or environmental causes, for example Optics giving out free reading glasses to kids.
